name: Figma
whatYouLose: Real-time collaborative canvas with CRDT sync
prompt: Build a simple vector design tool with: canvas with shapes (rect, ellipse, text), drag-to-move and resize handles, layers panel, color picker, export to PNG/SVG, and undo/redo. Use HTML Canvas or SVG. Single-user, no collaboration. This is a learning exercise — not a Figma replacement.
notes: Figma is a decade of engineering. A basic shape editor is vibecodable; a production design tool is not.
